en: Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor accompanied by rapture (*pītisahagata*), a state that is a root and accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for the root [condition] … pe … three for the non-disappearance [condition].

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor accompanied by pleasure (*sukhasahagata*), a state that is a root and accompanied by pleasure arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for the root [condition] … pe … three for the non-disappearance [condition].

Dependent on a non-root state not accompanied by equanimity, a root state accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.
